maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from advertising, media, PR and marketing services for brands, not repair or maintenance of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are private brands and companies (consumer, healthcare, tech); advertising is paid by businesses, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through agency networks and client wins; the large IPG merger was one big deal, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Brands can review and switch advertising and media agencies, though data and media integration adds some friction.

notes: Switching difficulty is moderate; agency reviews happen regularly, so mission_critical is a judgement call.
